newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on live sales, compared to Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow, with demand and seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Wednesday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not tested.

Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales. Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 100.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs few 101.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 98.00.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
